text: Decide how to repair 4 ideas with cost 0 that the backend cannot read
description: verify:migration found 4 ideas whose cost is 0 while IdeaSchema requires cost > 0, so idea.get fails and every list silently skips them (pre-existing, not caused by the migration): 6bbb740c "graph view", 8fc387d5, b3b7e429 "project meta settings", e552723a. Options: (a) a data migration setting cost 0 → 1 (the schema default), (b) allow cost 0 in the schema if "free" is meaningful, (c) fix the four by hand. Recommendation: (a) as migration 4, since cost 0 has no meaning in the value model (division by cost).

status.comment: Needs Felix: is cost 0 ever intended, or should a migration set it to 1?
